proposed_comments.title: Do not select an arbitrary SDK executable as the extension bootstrap

confidence.rationale: The current object-form bin branch selects the first string-valued property when cmdpal-bootstrap is absent, so package property order can launch an unrelated executable instead of falling through to the known bootstrap artifacts.

proposed_comments.body:
### Do not select an arbitrary SDK executable as the extension bootstrap

**Severity:** `high`

When `bin` is an object without `cmdpal-bootstrap`, the current fallback selects its first string-valued property. Package property order is not a bootstrap contract, so a package exposing multiple executables can launch an unrelated SDK CLI and fail to start the extension correctly. Only honor the explicit `cmdpal-bootstrap` entry, then fall through to the documented bootstrap artifacts, and add regression coverage for an object containing multiple string-valued entries.
